description: Every ranked category (product type): slug, title, section, parent, how many apps are tiered, its #1 app, ranking_status (ranked; under_review: fewer than 6 apps checked against it yet; too_few: fewer than 6 apps in it at all; either way no ranking and no #1) and under_review_count (apps listed but not checked yet). Use the slug with get_category. verbose=true adds each definition, excludes, counts and URLs (about 10x larger). Default: active only; status=all includes drafts (unpublished, being built) and archived (kept, no longer recommended).

verbose.description: include definitions, excludes, counts and URLs

name: list_categories
title: List categories
